maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from listings, advertising and SaaS subscriptions for cannabis retailers and brands, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private cannabis dispensaries and brands for marketplace advertising and software; no government payer.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically via Weedmaps marketplace ads and SaaS; acquisitions (e.g., Cannabis Business Solutions, Sprout) are occasional.

mission_critical.reason: WM Business SaaS and POS/CRM tools run dispensary operations, and Weedmaps has a large consumer audience, so switching is costly.

notes: Switching cost is moderate: advertising is easier to move than embedded POS/software.
